title: Twisted's First Mod
description: This is my first Minecraft mod where I have created a block that gives you a random potion every time you break it, and some other shananigans as well!
body:
This is my very first Minecraft mod, and it's all about potions, surprises, and a bit of chaos! I've created a special block that gives you a random potion every time you break it—who knows what you'll get? Instant health? Invisibility? Maybe even something... a little more explosive?

But that’s not all—there are a few other shenanigans packed in here too. Like some fancy blocks you could maybe use to build a structure or two. Use those block to craft something or not.

Features:

A custom block that drops a random potion on break

Great for spicing up survival or messing around with friends

Just break blocks and enjoy the madness—because Minecraft should never be too predictable.
